maela_kett_the_wary_tavernkeeper.name: Maela Kett, the wary tavernkeeper
maela_kett_the_wary_tavernkeeper.description: A sharp-eyed woman with close-cropped hair and a sleeve of faded tattoos. She keeps a constant watch over patrons and the bar’s battered safe, wary since recent troubles. She knows much of the town’s secrets but trusts few.

constable_farrel_dun.name: Constable Farrel Dun
constable_farrel_dun.description: The doughty, sharp-eyed local lawman with a bristly mustache, Farrel Dun is known for his even temper and sense of duty. He’s quick to help townsfolk and visitors alike, though his patience for nonsense is limited. Farrel is protective of his staff and wary of outsiders meddling in village affairs, but he values honesty and courage.

old_ellyn_the_folklore_spinner.name: Old Ellyn, the folklore spinner
old_ellyn_the_folklore_spinner.description: A spry, sharp-tongued elder with wild silver hair and a knack for captivating crowds with local legends. Ellyn is beloved by children and tolerated by adults, possessing an uncanny memory for the Vale’s strangest tales—some of which may hold real clues.

gritch_the_one_eared_nervous_patron.name: Gritch the One-Eared, nervous patron
gritch_the_one_eared_nervous_patron.description: A twitchy, shabby man with a missing ear, Gritch is a regular at Duskmantle Curios. He’s often found pawing through oddments, muttering about curses and treasures. Gritch is evasive but knows more about local criminal dealings than he lets on.

red_maw_scouts.name: Red Maw scouts
red_maw_scouts.description: Wary, mud-splattered members of the Red Maw gang, clad in patchwork leathers and bearing shortbows and knives. Their demeanor is tense—they’re on the lookout for rivals and authorities, but not immediately hostile unless threatened.

bram_of_the_stones_wandering_hermit.name: Bram of the Stones, wandering hermit
aliases: Bram of the Stones, wandering hermit

spirit_of_the_moor.name: Spirit of the Moor
spirit_of_the_moor.description: An ethereal, shimmering presence that manifests as a swirl of mist and faintly glowing eyes. The spirit speaks in riddles and warnings, watching over the standing stone and judging those who approach.

edrin_voss_eccentric_proprietor.name: Edrin Voss, eccentric proprietor
edrin_voss_eccentric_proprietor.description: A thin, wild-haired man with a patchwork vest and eyes always darting toward the mists outside. Spends as much time spinning tales as haggling over relics. He claims some items whisper secrets if you listen closely.

ghostly_royal_messenger.name: Ghostly Royal Messenger
ghostly_royal_messenger.description: A translucent figure in tattered livery, clutching spectral scrolls and nervously peering between the roads, forever waiting to deliver a message.

sable_reluctant_scribe_s_shade.name: Sable, Reluctant Scribe’s Shade
sable_reluctant_scribe_s_shade.description: A spectral scribe bound to the ledger, cursed to witness every name added. Sable flickers in and out of view, her ink-stained fingers trembling.

corsa_threadneedle_drenn.name: Corsa 'Threadneedle' Drenn
corsa_threadneedle_drenn.description: A wiry, sharp-eyed thief balancing on the ledge, watching both directions for pursuers or rivals. She is wary but open to negotiation if approached with respect or evidence of shared enemies.

irren_the_ragged.name: Irren the Ragged
irren_the_ragged.description: A gaunt, rag-clad prisoner hunched in the shadows of the cell, haunted but desperate for company. Once a lookout for the thieves, now abandoned and half-mad.

sergeant_halwin_reed.name: Sergeant Halwin Reed
sergeant_halwin_reed.description: A grizzled, even-tempered veteran with a deep respect for local traditions. Halwin ensures the safety of the vale with a mixture of discipline and gentle humor.

mrs_rindleby.name: Mrs. Rindleby
mrs_rindleby.description: A kindly halfling matron and amateur cartographer. She loves gossip, herbal teas, and puzzles, and is always eager for news from afar.

tamsin_quill.name: Tamsin Quill
tamsin_quill.description: A sharp-eyed gnome with a quick wit and quicker hands, Tamsin deals in curiosities, maps, and secrets. She’s as likely to trade for a good story as she is for coin.
